name: Pagey Site
tagline: Free static hosting, with no total site cap
description: Pagey Site lets agents publish an HTML file, ZIP archive, or static build folder and return a live HTTPS link. Hosting is free, with no subscription, credit card, or total site cap; registered accounts can create 25 new sites per UTC day. Preview files, update a site at the same address, choose a custom Pagey subdomain, control maintenance, and read analytics from chat. The Pagey dashboard also provides password protection, secure sharing, a file browser, an AI site builder, and a custom form builder with a built-in backend. All features are free for registered accounts; usage limits apply.

prompts.text: Publish this static build folder to Pagey Site and give me the link.
Update my existing Pagey site with this build and keep its address.
List my Pagey sites and show their visitor analytics for the last week.
